description: This PHP class 'MailMessage' extends Symfony's Email class to facilitate the creation and configuration of email messages within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set email subject, sender, recipients, body, and CC/BCC addresses, integrating with the system's Mail entity for content type handling.

classes.name: MailMessage
classes.description: A class that extends Symfony's Email to simplify constructing email messages within the OrangeHRM framework, supporting setting subject, sender, recipient, body, CC, BCC, and handling content types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new MailMessage object with a specified content type, defaulting to HTML.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject line of the email.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender addresses for the email.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient addresses for the email.

methods.name: setMailBody
methods.description: Sets the email body, choosing between plain text or HTML based on content type.
